title: Console: guided onboarding checklist UI shell behind feature flag
author: Hannah Rivera
body:
Summary
Adds the initial Guided Onboarding Checklist UI shell in the Console, gated behind a feature flag. This PR is intentionally “thin”: routing + layout + placeholder step rendering, so that subsequent PRs can land backend state + validations + telemetry without reworking the page structure.

Context
This is the first slice for the Guided Onboarding / First Production Launch initiative (PM-482, ENG-23110). The goal here is to unblock Design/PM review in a real environment and let Docs wire deep links in parallel.

What’s included
- Feature-flag gated entry point: flag key `console.guidedOnboardingChecklist` (default off)
- New route: `/console/:orgSlug/:projectSlug/onboarding` (uses existing org/project routing)
- New page shell: `OnboardingChecklistPage`
  - Left: checklist steps (placeholder data)
  - Right: “Learn more” / docs deep links (placeholder URLs for now)
  - Basic empty/loading state for the future async state model
- Re-usable components (minimal styling; aligns with Console design tokens)
  - `ChecklistStepRow` (title, description, CTA)
  - `ChecklistProgressHeader` (percent complete derived from placeholder data)
- Nav entry (hidden unless flag enabled): “Getting started” → “Guided onboarding”
- Basic unit tests for route + flag gating

Non-goals / intentionally deferred
- No server-side checklist state (ENG-23111)
- No validation signals (first request / streaming / etc.) (ENG-23113+)
- No onboarding telemetry events (ENG-23112)
- No cohort targeting / allowlist logic (ENG-23118)

Implementation notes
- The page is structured around a `ChecklistModel` interface so we can swap placeholder steps for API-driven state with minimal churn.
- Current placeholder steps are a short subset for layout validation only; final step list will come from PRD/UX spec.
- For deep links, I added a `getDocsUrl(stepKey)` helper with TODOs; Design requested we follow the new UTM convention but we’re waiting on DES-115 to land the final schema.

Screenshots
- With flag off: no visible nav changes; direct route redirects to project overview.
- With flag on: “Guided onboarding” page renders with placeholder steps and CTA buttons.

Testing
- `pnpm test console` (passes)
- `pnpm lint` (passes)
- Manual: verified route + nav gating locally with flag override

Rollout / ops
- Flag is default-off in all envs.
- No migrations, no backend changes.

Review notes / follow-ups
- After merge, next PR will start wiring real step data + step states from the backend API (ENG-23111) and replace the placeholder list.

Conversation (highlights)
Dylan Brooks (review): Please ensure the route guard for flag-off doesn’t leak a “blank page” state; redirect is fine. Also, can we avoid hardcoding docs URLs in the component?
Hannah Rivera (author): Updated to redirect to project overview when flag is off. Split docs URL mapping into `docsLinks.ts` so it’s not embedded in the page component; left TODOs for DES-115.

Kenji Nakamura (review): Spacing/typography looks close, but the step rows need a clearer focus state for keyboard nav.
Hannah Rivera (author): Added `:focus-visible` outline and ensured CTA buttons are reachable in tab order.

Chloe Martin (review): Minor: make sure projectSlug is required in the route definition; we’ve had bugs where org-only routes accidentally match.
Hannah Rivera (author): Fixed route match ordering and added a test to prevent regression.

Jada Williams (review): +1 on interface-first model. Please keep the placeholder state shape aligned with what backend will likely return (stepKey, state, completedAt).
Hannah Rivera (author): Adjusted placeholder data to include `state` and `completedAt` (null for now) and used that in progress computation.

Approvals
- Dylan Brooks: Approved
- Kenji Nakamura: Approved
- Chloe Martin: Approved

CI
- build-console: pass
- test-console: pass
- lint: pass

Merge
Squash merged into `main` as: “Console: guided onboarding checklist UI shell behind feature flag”

console(onboarding): add checklist step row components + placeholder model
console(onboarding): gate nav + route behind feature flag
test(console): add routing + feature flag unit tests
style(console): align checklist shell with design tokens + focus states
